hypothesis: The theorem-equivalent raw and demodulated forms of a clause are not interchangeable search states because they preserve different continuation opportunities.

conditions.S: frozen 1:4 age/weight scheduler with goal quota and no forward demodulation
conditions.FS: the same scheduler plus at most four local demodulations using the last eight eligible rules

trace_alignment.earliest_divergence: first selection index at which aligned selection identities differ

counterfactual_protocol.scope: each demodulation in the accepted FS proof ancestry
counterfactual_protocol.intervention: block exactly one stable rewrite identity and rerun the same deterministic FS configuration
counterfactual_protocol.necessary: the verified proof no longer closes after deleting the rewrite
counterfactual_protocol.replaceable: a verified proof closes through a different ancestry
counterfactual_protocol.incidental: the verified proof closes with the same remaining ancestry signatures
counterfactual_protocol.harmful: FS loses a proof found by S after the earliest rewrite-driven selection divergence

decision_rule: Recommend only fields whose values explain a proof gain, proof loss, or necessary counterfactual rewrite in the paired traces. Do not modify production.
